phrases.english: 1.Praise belongs to God,
2.the First, without a first before Him,

phrases.arabic: وَ الاخِر بِلاَ آخِر يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ
phrases.english: 3.the Last, without a last behind Him.
4.Beholders' eyes fall short of seeing Him,

phrases.arabic: وَ عَجَزَتْ عَنْ نَعْتِهِ أَوهامُ اَلْوَاصِفِينَ
phrases.english: 5.describers' imaginations are not able to depict Him.
6.He originated the creatures through His power with an origination,
7.He devised them in accordance with His will with a devising.
8.Then He made them walk on the path of His desire,
9.He sent them out on the way of His love.
10.They cannot keep back from that to which He has sent them forward,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَقَدُّماً إلَى مَا أَخَّرَهُمْ عَنْهُ،
phrases.english: 11.nor can they go forward to that from which He has kept them back.
12.He assigned from His provision to each of their spirits
13.a nourishment known and apportioned.
14.No decreaser decreases those whom He increases,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَزِيدُ مَنْ نَقَصَ منْهُمْ زَائِدٌ
phrases.english: 15.no increaser increases those of them whom He decreases.

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَجَلاً مَوْقُوتاً،
phrases.english: 16.Then for each spirit He strikes a fixed term in life,
17.for each He sets up a determined end;
18.he walks toward it through the days of his span,
19.he overtakes it through the years of his time.
20.Then, when he takes his final step
21.and embraces the reckoning of his span,
22.God seizes him to the abundant reward

phrases.arabic: مِنْ مَوْفُورِ ثَوَابِهِ أَوْ مَحْذُورِ عِقَابِهِ،
phrases.english: 23.or the feared punishment to which He has called him,
24."That He may repay those who do evil for what they have done
25.and repay those who do good with goodness" (53:31),
26.as justice from Him (holy are His names,
27.and manifest His boons).

phrases.arabic: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
phrases.english: 28."He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall be questioned" (21:23).

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لَوْ حَبَسَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَعْرِفَةَ
phrases.english: 29.Praise belongs to God, for, had He withheld from His servants the knowledge

phrases.arabic: حَمْدِهِ عَلَى مَا أَبْلاَهُمْ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ الْمُتَتَابِعَةِ
phrases.english: 30.to praise Him for the uninterrupted kindnesses with which He has tried them
31.and the manifest favours which He has lavished upon them,
32.they would have moved about in His kindnesses without praising Him,
33.and spread themselves out in His provision without thanking Him.

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانُوا كَذلِكَ لَخَرَجُوا مِنْ حُدُودِ الانْسَانِيَّةِ
phrases.english: 34.Had such been the case, they would have left the bounds of humanity
35.for that of beastliness
36.and become as He has described in the firm text of His Book:

phrases.arabic: ( إنْ هُمْ إلا كَالانْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلا )
phrases.english: 37."They are but as the cattle—nay, but they are further astray from the way"! (25:46)

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنا من نفسه
phrases.english: 38.Praise belongs to God, for the true knowledge of Himself He has given to us,
39.the thanksgiving He has inspired us to offer Him,

phrases.arabic: وَفَتَحَ لَنَا من أبوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيّته
phrases.english: 40.the doors to knowing His Lordship He has opened for us,

phrases.arabic: وَدَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الاِخْلاَصِ لَهُ فِي تَوْحِيدِهِ
phrases.english: 41.the sincerity towards Him in professing His Unity to which He has led us,

phrases.arabic: وَجَنَّبَنا مِنَ الالْحَادِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي أَمْرِهِ،
phrases.english: 42.and the deviation and doubt in His Command from which He has turned us aside;

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
phrases.english: 43.a praise through which we may be given long life among those of His creatures who praise Him,

phrases.arabic: وَنَسْبِقُ بِـهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إلَى رِضَاهُ وَعَفْوِهِ
phrases.english: 44.and overtake those who have gone ahead toward His good pleasure and pardon;

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً يُضِيءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ
phrases.english: 45.a praise through which He will illuminate for us the shadows of the interworld,
46.ease for us the path of the Resurrection,

phrases.arabic: وَيُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الاشْهَادِ
phrases.english: 47.and raise up our stations at the standing places of the Witnesses

phrases.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ
phrases.english: 48."on the day when every soul will be repaid for what it has earned - they shall not be wronged" (45:21);

phrases.arabic: (يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلىً عَنْ مَوْلىً شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ)
phrases.english: 49."the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped" (44:41);

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ
phrases.english: 50.a praise which will rise up from us to the highest of the 'Illiyun
51."in a book inscribed, witnessed by those brought nigh" (83:20-21),

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إذَا بَرِقَت الابْصَارُ
phrases.english: 52.a praise whereby our eyes may be at rest when sight is dazzled,

phrases.arabic: وَتَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الابْشَارُ،
phrases.english: 53.our faces whitened when skins are blackened,

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله
phrases.english: 54.a praise through which we may be released from God's painful Fire
55.and enter God's generous neighbourhood,
56.a praise by which we may jostle the angels brought nigh
57.and join the prophets, the envoys,

phrases.arabic: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ
phrases.english: 58.in a House of Permanence that does not remove,
59.the Place of His Generosity that does not change.

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
phrases.english: 60.Praise belongs to God, who chose for us the good qualities of creation,
61.granted us the agreeable things of provision,

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
phrases.english: 62.and appointed for us excellence through domination over all creation;
63.every one of His creatures submits to us through His power
64.and comes to obey us through His might.

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 65.Praise belongs to God, who locked for us the gate of need except toward Him.

phrases.arabic: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
phrases.english: 66.So how can we praise Him? When can we thank Him? Indeed, when?

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ
phrases.english: 67.Praise belongs to God, who placed within us the organs of expansion,
68.assigned for us the agents of contraction,
69.gave us to enjoy the spirits of life,
70.fixed within us the limbs of works,
71.nourished us with the agreeable things of provision,
72.freed us from need through His bounty,
73.and gave us possessions through His kindness.
74.Then He commanded us that He might test our obedience

phrases.arabic: وَنَهَانَا لِيَبْتَلِيَ شُكْرَنَا فَخَالَفْنَا عَنْ طَرِيْقِ أمْرِهِ
phrases.english: 75.and prohibited us that He might try our thanksgiving. So we turned against the path of His commandments
76.and mounted the backs of His warnings.
77.Yet He hurried us not to His punishment,nor hastened us on to His vengeance, ,

phrases.arabic: بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
phrases.english: 78.No, He went slowly with us through His mercy, in generosity, and awaited our return through His clemency, in mildness.
79.Praise belongs to God, who showed us the way to repentance,

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
phrases.english: 80.which we would not have won save through His bounty.
81.Had we nothing to count as His bounty
82.but this, His trial of us would have been good,
83.His beneficence toward us great,
84.His bounty upon us immense.

phrases.arabic: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ
phrases.english: 85.For such was not His wont in repentance
86.with those who went before us.
87.He has lifted up from us
88."what we have not the strength to bear"(2:286) ,
89.charged us only to our capacity,
90.imposed upon us nothing but ease,

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
phrases.english: 91.and left none of us with an argument or excuse.
92.So the perisher among us is he who perishes in spite of Him
93.and the felicitous among us he who beseeches Him.

phrases.arabic: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
phrases.english: 94.And praise belongs to God with all the praises of
95.His angels closest to Him,
96.His creatures most noble in His eyes,
97.and His praisers most pleasing to Him;
98.a praise that may surpass other praises
99.as our Lord surpasses all His creatures.
100.Then to Him belongs praise,
101.in place of His every favour upon us

phrases.arabic: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
phrases.english: 102.and upon all His servants, past and still remaining,

phrases.arabic: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِالاشْيَآءِ
phrases.english: 103.to the number of all things His knowledge encompasses,

phrases.arabic: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا
phrases.english: 104.and in place of each of His favours,

phrases.arabic: أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
phrases.english: 105.their number doubling and redoubling always and forever, to the Day of Resurrection;
106.a praise whose bound has no utmost end,
107.whose number has no reckoning,
108.whose limit cannot be reached,
109.whose period cannot be cut off;

phrases.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
phrases.english: 110.a praise which will become a link to His obedience and pardon,
111.a tie to His good pleasure,
112.a means to His forgiveness,
113.a path to His Garden,
114.a protector against His vengeance,
115.a security against His wrath,
116.an aid to obeying Him,
117.a barrier against disobeying Him,

phrases.arabic: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
phrases.english: 118.a help in fulfilling His right and His duties;

phrases.arabic: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
phrases.english: 119.a praise that will make us felicitous among His felicitous friends,

phrases.arabic: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
phrases.english: 120.and bring us into the ranks of those martyred by the swords of His enemies.
121.He is a Friend, Praiseworthy!
